moments.title: Commonwealth Games Closing Ceremony
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games conclude on Sunday, August 2nd with a closing ceremony headlined by Scottish rock legends Simple Minds.

angles.name: Big Finish
angles.copy: Glasgow gets ready to wave goodbye to the Commonwealth Games 2026! Simple Minds are set to headline the closing ceremony on August 2nd. Who's been your sporting highlight?

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Simple Minds closing out the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow? Iconic. Get ready for a Scottish send-off on August 2nd that'll be heard around the world!

moments.title: Love Island 2026 Final
moments.blurb: The 13th season of Love Island UK concludes with its grand final on Monday, July 27th, live on ITV2 and ITVX, crowning the winning couple.

angles.name: Final Countdown
angles.copy: The Love Island 2026 final is upon us! Who's taking home the £50k tomorrow night? Tune in to ITV2 and ITVX at 9pm for all the drama.

angles.name: Who Will Win?
angles.copy: One more sleep until the Love Island final! After weeks of bombshells and recouplings, which couple deserves to be crowned this year's winners?

moments.title: Latitude Festival Closes Today

angles.name: Festival Finale
angles.copy: It's the final day of Latitude Festival in Suffolk! Lewis Capaldi closes out the weekend tonight. Who caught him live?

angles.name: Suffolk Sounds
angles.copy: Latitude Festival wraps up its 20th edition today! Henham Park has been buzzing with music, comedy, and arts all weekend. What was your favourite moment?

moments.title: Mick Jagger's 83rd Birthday

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! The Rolling Stones frontman is still rocking stages worldwide. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Still Got It
angles.copy: 83 years young! Mick Jagger, the ultimate rock 'n' roll star, celebrates his birthday today. Here's to many more years of moves and music!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Number 1 spot for an 18th non-consecutive week, matching an all-time record, as the Official Charts update for week ending July 30, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: History in the making! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 for an 18th week, matching the all-time record. Can it break it next week?

angles.name: New Music Monday Tease
angles.copy: The UK Singles Chart is in! 'Rein Me In' is still top, but Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is climbing fast. Who's your money on for next week's Number 1?
